name: Self-Employment Permit (Business Owner)

requirements.blocker_text: Law on Granting Permit for Work and Employment of Foreign Citizens establishes dedicated self-employment permit categories distinct from the employer-sponsored track: Type D (1 year) and Type E (5 years) are issued specifically for self-employment/business ownership rather than employment by a third party. No minimum-capital threshold or business-registration specifics were confirmed in the excerpt reviewed in this build, but the existence of a dedicated self-employment permit category (rather than folding business owners into the general employer-sponsored track, as Mali and Haiti do) is itself a distinct, confirmed structural feature.
requirements.fix_path: Register the business in Kosovo and apply for a Type D (1-year) or Type E (5-year) self-employment permit.

sources.title: Republic of Kosovo (official government-hosted primary legal text) -- Law on Granting Permit for Work and Employment of Foreign Citizens, self-employment permit Types D and E
